summary: Comic's Choice is a British comedy chat show hosted by comedian Bill Bailey and broadcast on Channel 4. It ran for one series of five episodes shown in January 2011. In each episode Bailey interviewed another British comedian about their favourite comedians or comedy television programmes. The series was produced by Unique Television Production.
one_line: Comic's Choice is a 2011 Channel 4 comedy chat show in which Bill Bailey interviewed British comedians about their favourite comedy.
